blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former political prisoners and Indigenous Peoples rights defenders on Monday filed a motion for reconsideration before the Office of the Ombudsman over the complaints of alleged illegal arrest and detention, among others, that they filed against five police officers. According to complainants Niezel Agudo and Julieta Gomez, they were allegedly arrested illegally during a joint military and police operation in July 2021 in Quezon City and accused of charges such as illegal possession of firearms and attempted murder.
